findings.description: The duplicate guard tracks only the derived unit string. For an INSTRUMENT plan with two arms and n_per_arm=1, retain one pre-freeze clip and one post-freeze Evidence record. Two distinct InstrumentRun IDs can both reference that exact Evidence, with one matching EvidenceArm link per arm; evidence_roles.validate_admission permits these records. Submitting that Evidence pin once for each arm selects different POST_FREEZE_RUN links, produces distinct run:<id> units and satisfies both counts. No check rejects reuse of the Evidence pin. A stopping design likewise accepts a stopping.samples list containing that pin twice because it compares sorted multisets without checking uniqueness. This defeats Plan criterion 5's duplicate-submission/cross-arm-reuse requirement and the documented duplicate-sample rejection. The existing instrument regression uses two revisions of the same run ID, so it misses this path.
